content:
A forecast highlighted in reporting on AI infrastructure projected that electricity demand from AI chips could rise by more than 1,100% from 2025 levels by 2033.

The estimate placed worldwide AI-chip power demand at roughly 315 gigawatts in 2033, with the United States potentially accounting for about 200 gigawatts.

The report described grid capacity, permitting, backup generation and data-center connections as constraints on the expansion of large AI computing facilities.

These are the same demand projections and infrastructure concerns reported in the original article; no new forecast is introduced.
headline: Global AI chip power consumption forecasted to expand 1,100% to 315 gigawatts
summary: Electricity demands from AI data centers are projected to surge 1,100% to 315 gigawatts globally by 2033.
